narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Five dee plus six equals three dee plus six, and that means the daughter is zero.
<bookmark mark='box'/>The mother will be three times the daughter's whole future age, which is dee plus six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The three must multiply both parts of that age, so a bracket is needed.
